# DeepLearning.AI

> > DeepLearning.AI is an educational platform founded by Andrew Ng offering courses, specializations, and resources in deep learning, generative AI, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and agentic AI systems.

The platform provides both comprehensive specializations and short courses covering topics from beginner to advanced levels, partnering with organizations like Coursera, OpenAI, Google, and AI21 Labs. DeepLearning.AI also publishes The Batch, a weekly newsletter covering AI news, research breakthroughs, and industry developments.

## Key Topics

- Agentic AI and AI Agents
- Generative AI and Large Language Models
- TensorFlow and PyTorch
- Coding Agents and Software Development
- Transformers and Attention Mechanisms
- Data-Centric AI
- Model Deployment and Production
- AI Safety and Security
- Deep Learning Fundamentals
- Data Analytics with AI
- Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini
- Scientific Computing and AI for Science
- Computer Vision and GANs
- Natural Language Processing
- AI Ethics and Policy

## Core Courses and Specializations

- [TensorFlow: Advanced Techniques Specialization](https://www.deeplearning.ai/courses/tensorflow-advanced-techniques-specialization): Advanced TensorFlow specialization covering GANs, custom layers & deployment
- [TensorFlow: Data and Deployment Specialization](https://www.deeplearning.ai/courses/tensorflow-data-and-deployment-specialization): TensorFlow deployment specialization for mobile, browser & data pipelines
- [Data Analytics Professional Certificate](https://www.deeplearning.ai/courses/data-analytics): Professional certificate in data analytics with Python, SQL & generative AI
- [Attention in Transformers: Concepts and Code in PyTorch](https://www.deeplearning.ai/alpha/short-courses/attention-in-transformers-concepts-and-code-in-pytorch): PyTorch course on attention mechanisms in transformers by Josh Starmer
- [Building AI Browser Agents](https://www.deeplearning.ai/alpha/short-courses/building-ai-browser-agents): Course on building web automation agents with AgentQ framework
- [Build Long-Context AI Apps with Jamba](https://www.deeplearning.ai/alpha/short-courses/build-long-context-ai-apps-with-jamba): Jamba model course for processing long documents with AI21 Labs

## The Batch: AI News and Insights

- [The Batch Newsletter](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch): Weekly AI newsletter covering news, policy and industry updates
- [Anthropic Updates Flagship Claude Opus to 4.6](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/anthropic-updates-flagship-claude-opus-to-4-6-places-first-on-intelligence-index): Claude Opus 4.6 release with adaptive thinking and extended context
- [Software Developers Used More Versatile AI Agent-Powered Tools](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/software-developers-used-more-versatile-ai-agent-powered-tools-to-write-code): AI coding agents evolution from autocomplete to agentic systems
- [Crowdsourced Context for Coding Agents](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/crowdsourced-context-for-coding-agents): Context Hub announcement for providing API docs to coding agents
- [SAIL's Science Context Protocol for AI Agents](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/sails-science-context-protocol-helps-ai-agents-communicate-about-local-and-virtual-experiments): Science Context Protocol for autonomous AI research agents by SAIL
- [Data Points: China and Nvidia Make a Deal](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/china-and-nvidia-make-a-deal): AI news roundup on Nvidia-China trade, music AI, and health applications
- [Data Points: During Bay Area Blackout, Waymo Conks Out](https://www.deeplearning.ai/the-batch/during-bay-area-blackout-waymo-conks-out): AI news on Waymo blackout failure, GPT-5.2 Codex and audio separation
